name: application-webhook-event-row
title: Webhook Event Row
description: Webhook delivery event row with an event name, real delivery status pill, HTTP response code, and a Retry action that only appears for failed deliveries.
useWhen: Listing recent webhook delivery attempts with their event type, status, and HTTP response code.
Failed deliveries need a manual retry action that successful or pending deliveries don't show.
You want the status pill and available actions to always match the real delivery status.
avoidWhen: You need the full request/response payload inline — pair this row with an expandable detail panel instead.
The event isn't from a webhook delivery system — use a generic log-viewer or sync-status-row instead.
You need bulk retry across many events — add a bulk-action-bar above a list of these rows.
responsiveBehavior: The row is a single flex line; event name and timestamp are shrink-0 so they stay legible while the status/response/retry cluster stays right-aligned at any width.
accessibility: Delivery status is conveyed by both pill color and a text label (Delivered/Failed/Pending), not color alone.
The Retry button only renders for failed deliveries with a real onRetry handler, so it's never a dead or inappropriate action.
Event name and response code use monospace styling to distinguish them as identifiers/codes from prose text.

variants.title: Webhook event row
variants.description: Three delivery rows (delivered/pending/failed) showing status, response code, and a conditional Retry action, on a light surface.
accessibility: Only the failed row shows a Retry button, since retrying an already-delivered or still-pending event isn't a valid action.

variants.title: Webhook event row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three delivery states, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status pill and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
